title: Mitsuba Fritters French Style
description: A crispy and flavorful French-inspired mitsuba fritter recipe that's easy to make and perfect as a snack.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together flour, eggs, buttermilk, salt, garlic powder, and paprika.
Add mitsuba to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the mitsuba mixture into the oil, forming small fritters.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate.
Sprinkle the fritters with breadcrumbs and serve hot.
